plugins.cameraPermission: Witness uses the camera to read the asset tag on a part. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.

extra.note: Android only by design. iOS provisioning is a demo-day risk we chose not to take.
extra.devClient: Runs in Expo Go as configured. For a standalone APK later: npx expo install expo-dev-client, then add "expo-dev-client" back to the plugins array above. Keep the package and the plugin list in sync - listing a plugin without installing it is a hard startup error.
